title: It is the AI fault not mine: Mind perception increases blame attribution to AI

items.verbatim_quote: comparatively little attention has been given to explicit moral transgressions instigated by AIs.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，现有研究主要关注自动驾驶汽车事故或AI道德困境，而对AI引发的明确道德违规关注较少。

items.verbatim_quote: they did not manipulate the mind perception, and only included mind-perception as a covariate along with other manipulations, obscuring the clear causal path between mind perception and blame attribution.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，Shank等人的研究未操纵心智感知，仅将其作为协变量，因此未能明确心智感知与责备归因之间的因果关系。

items.verbatim_quote: the study provides weak support for a causal relationship, as the data were correlational.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，研究1的数据是相关性的，因此对因果关系的支持较弱。

items.verbatim_quote: in Study 2, we manipulated the levels of perceived AI mind in scenarios to directly assess their impact on the attribution of moral responsibility.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者提出，在研究2中通过操纵AI心智感知水平来直接评估其对道德责任归因的影响，以建立因果关系。
items.methodological_detail_cn: 在研究2中，通过实验操纵AI心智感知水平，以直接评估其对道德责任归因的因果影响。

items.verbatim_quote: they did not manipulate the mind perception, and only included mind-perception as a covariate along with other manipulations, obscuring the clear causal path between mind perception and blame attribution.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评Shank等人的研究未操纵心智感知，仅将其作为协变量，导致心智感知与责备归因之间的因果关系不明确。

items.verbatim_quote: existing studies have predominantly focused on moral dilemmas involving AIs [27].
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评现有研究主要关注涉及AI的道德困境，而忽视了明确的道德违规。

items.verbatim_quote: One limitation of Studies 1 and 2 was that only the AI was explicitly referenced as an agent within the scenario, in contrast to others (e.g., the programmer). Consequently, an alternative explanation may emerge, wherein the influence of mind perception on individuals’ tendency to attribute moral culpability to AI becomes confounded with their exclusive presence as agents within the scenario.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认研究1和2的一个局限：场景中只有AI被明确提及为行动者，而其他方（如程序员）未被提及，这可能导致对AI的归责受到其作为唯一行动者的混淆。

items.verbatim_quote: Despite these speculations, given the sensitivity of our results to how blame was measured, caution should be exercised in interpreting the findings.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，由于结果对责备测量方式敏感，解释发现时需谨慎。

items.verbatim_quote: Firstly, the stimuli utilized may not fully encompass the diverse array of scenarios found in real-world AI-related moral violations.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认所用刺激材料可能未完全涵盖现实世界中AI相关道德违规的多样性场景。

items.verbatim_quote: Secondly, as inherent in vignette studies, there remains uncertainty regarding the extent to which participants’ judgments reflect their reactions in actual situations involving AI.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，由于是情境研究，参与者的判断在多大程度上反映其在真实AI情境中的反应仍不确定。

items.verbatim_quote: Also, this study focuses on blame as a cognitive process rather than as a negative affective response, such as anger or hostility.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，本研究关注的是作为认知过程的责备，而非愤怒或敌意等负面情感反应。

items.verbatim_quote: We asked participants to distribute responsibility among various agents using a numerical scale based on previous studies [6,22]. However, this approach risks oversimplifying the complexities of the responsibility attribution process.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，使用数字量表分配责任可能过度简化了责任归因过程的复杂性。

items.verbatim_quote: Moreover, the non-nationally representative sample used in the experiment may limit the generalizability of the findings, especially considering that online samples tend to comprise individuals with a certain level of technological literacy and comfort.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，实验使用的非全国代表性样本可能限制发现的普遍性，尤其在线样本往往由具备一定技术素养和舒适度的个体组成。

items.verbatim_quote: future studies should aim to address this limitation by employing more comprehensive stimuli. For example, employing situational sampling techniques could facilitate the collection and categorization of a broader range of such incidents.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究采用更全面的刺激材料，例如使用情境抽样技术来收集和分类更广泛的AI道德违规事件。
items.methodological_detail_cn: 采用情境抽样技术收集和分类更广泛的AI道德违规事件。

items.verbatim_quote: Since affective responses are often triggered by cognitive blame, future research should explore how emotional reactions fluctuate depending on mind perception.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究探索情感反应如何随心智感知而波动，因为情感反应常由认知责备触发。
items.current_theoretical_limit_cn: 当前研究仅关注责备的认知过程，未考察情感反应。
items.proposed_theoretical_move_cn: 探索心智感知如何影响情感反应，从而扩展责备归因的机制理解。
items.relationship_or_prediction_to_test_cn: 检验心智感知与情感反应（如愤怒、敌意）之间的关系。

items.verbatim_quote: Future studies should further investigate the relationship between cognitive and affective components of blame, particularly in the context of AI moral transgressions.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究进一步探讨责备的认知成分与情感成分之间的关系，特别是在AI道德违规情境中。
items.current_theoretical_limit_cn: 责备的认知与情感成分之间的关系尚不清楚。
items.proposed_theoretical_move_cn: 明确责备的认知与情感成分之间的区别与联系，以完善责备构念。
items.relationship_or_prediction_to_test_cn: 检验责备的认知成分与情感成分在AI道德违规情境中的关系。

items.verbatim_quote: Future studies should incorporate more comprehensive measures that capture the multidimensional nature of responsibility attribution, such as qualitative analyses of the reasons and amounts of blame assigned, as well as behavioral measures [10].
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究采用更全面的测量方法，如定性分析责备的原因和数量，以及行为测量，以捕捉责任归因的多维性。
items.methodological_detail_cn: 采用定性分析责备的原因和数量，以及行为测量。

items.verbatim_quote: Therefore, future studies should strive to recruit more diverse and representative samples, such as through in-person community recruitment.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究招募更多样化和有代表性的样本，例如通过线下社区招募。
items.methodological_detail_cn: 通过线下社区招募更多样化和有代表性的样本。

items.verbatim_quote: Prior research in the literature predominantly centered on moral dilemmas or accidents, scenarios lacking deliberate violations of moral norms by any party involved [4–7].
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评先前研究主要关注道德困境或事故，这些场景缺乏任何一方故意违反道德规范。

items.verbatim_quote: Even though mind perception has been examined in correlational studies [23], no prior study manipulated mind perception in the context of AI transgression.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，尽管心智感知已在相关研究中被检验，但尚无研究在AI违规情境中操纵心智感知。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: we explore the potential for mind perception to contribute to moral scapegoating of AI.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者提出，心智感知可能促进对AI的道德替罪羊现象，即责备从人类转移到AI。
raw_item.current_theoretical_limit_cn: 现有研究多关注AI-人类联合决策中的责任分配，但未充分探讨心智感知如何导致对AI的道德替罪羊现象，即责备从更远端的人类代理人（如公司）转移到AI。
raw_item.proposed_theoretical_move_cn: 将道德替罪羊理论扩展到AI情境，检验心智感知是否增加对AI的责备并减少对其他代理人的责备。
raw_item.relationship_or_prediction_to_test_cn: 心智感知与对AI责备增加、对公司责备减少之间的关系。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: Longitudinal studies or experiments conducted in naturalistic settings could provide further insights into participants’ responses to AI-related moral dilemmas.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究采用纵向研究或自然情境实验，以深入了解参与者对AI道德困境的反应。
raw_item.methodological_detail_cn: 采用纵向研究或自然情境实验。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: our findings underscore the importance of further research into the underlying mechanisms of blame attribution relevant to AI entities, as well as the development of strategies to prevent unjust scapegoating.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者强调未来研究需要探索AI实体责备归因的潜在机制，并制定防止不公正替罪羊的策略。
raw_item.current_theoretical_limit_cn: 对AI实体责备归因的潜在机制了解不足。
raw_item.proposed_theoretical_move_cn: 识别和检验AI责备归因的因果机制，以解释心智感知如何导致替罪羊现象。
raw_item.relationship_or_prediction_to_test_cn: 检验心智感知与责备归因之间的中介或调节机制。
